# Markov-state-based approach to momentum/trend forecasting

A concept shared by **74** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #433. The CSV rates every member: *Low confidence — reconstructed from the algorithm title; executable rules and source support are not established.* None is implemented in volatility-ai.

## Description

Proposed Markov-state-based approach to momentum/trend forecasting: Estimate directional or relative strength from historical prices, returns, or factor signals and translate the forecast into rankings or portfolio exposure; the forecast horizon and position rules are not specified. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
